snippet.title: Astral Bounty Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Four ships. Four levels. One account that shrinks with every death.

Astral Bounty is an arcade shoot 'em up for everyone who misses Blood Money, R-Type and Xenon 2. Checkpoints cost credits. Dying costs credits. Your upgrades are gone when you go down. Welcome back to the 90s, just without swapping 12 floppy disks.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4952490/Astral_Bounty/

Developed by Weepel Games.
